1324967948071604225.a: For small datasets Amazon S3 is cheaper and way more secure, incidentally. S3 is $1.25/mo versus $1.99/mo for 100 GB. S3 is slightly more than Google Drive for larger datasets but without the idiot overlords rooting around in your private data.

1324969417307000832.a: In case anyone is wondering... The virus samples are inside of a Red Hat Linux distribution ISO circa 1990s. The virus scanner included with the CD included test viruses to make sure it works. So I have an entire hardware-specific custom ISO I can't download to run the hardware.
